C1181.title: AI Hallucinated Code Dependencies Spark Slopsquatting Supply Chain Attacks
C1181.summary: In April 2025, the malicious PyPI package ccxt-mexc-futures was disclosed as stealing MEXC trading-related credentials and redirecting orders. AI hallucinated dependency and slopsquatting attack principles should be separated from this specific malicious package event: the former refers to attackers registering fictitious package names generated by AI code and implanting malware, while the current references better support credential theft and order manipulation risk rather than confirmed million-dollar losses.
